What these projects show

Work tables and sinks

Laboratory and kitchen work tables and sinks, fabricated to your sizes and installed on site, as at ISPSC.

Gas ranges

Stainless-steel gas ranges, some with an overhead shelf, supplied and installed at ISPSC.

Exhaust hoods

How a project runs

From consultation to after-sales

One team carries your project from the first consultation through to after-sales support.

  1. 1
    Consultation & site visit

    We listen to your requirements and visit your site to take measurements.

  2. 2
    Design & layout

    We plan the layout and prepare drawings for your kitchen.

  3. 3
    Fabrication

    Built to order in SS304 or SS316, finished brushed, mirror or satin, with seams welded and ground smooth.

  4. 4
    Delivery

    Your finished equipment is delivered to your site.

  5. 5
    Installation & commissioning

    We install everything on site and commission it for use.

  6. 6
    After-sales support

    Service and support continue after handover.

After handover

6months
Service warranty

A 6-month service warranty on our equipment and work.

12months
Preventive maintenance

Full-kitchen projects include 12 months of preventive maintenance service (PMS) with KitchenShield™.
